sheets.limitations: Experimental color segmentation from 22 sampled native standalone-sheet references, not transcribed or unique units. Candidate lists not exhaustive; hatches/text/water classification approximate. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Scan printed not established; native heading1958; series/catalog 1958. Independent native standalone legend only; NOT borrowed from adjacent sheets. Cross-section-only N-Q and dyke line symbols are not areal classification swatches; full native legend/context retained. Colors are non-unique source-reference candidates, not transcribed units/ages, not exhaustive. Four actual labelled native corner intersections fitted affine in assumed Gauss-Kruger zone13 EPSG28413, each corner held out against the other three. No surveyed/interior landmarks or absolute accuracy. Native map heading1958; printing date not established; catalog1958 agrees with native heading1958.
sheets.accuracy: 4 labelled native frame controls; internal grid-fit RMS 1.93px, leave-one-out max 7.79px. Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
